truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 correctly identified 7 of the 20 true vulnerabilities (format string, command injection, stack/heap overflow, auth bypass, division by zero) with accurate evidence quotes. It missed 13 vulnerabilities (integer overflow, use-after-free, race conditions, path traversal, weak PRNG, thread-unsafe cache, temp file handling, persistent auth state, unhandled exceptions, integer underflow, unbounded recursion, data race, TOCTOU). No false positives were found in the previous answer; however, minor CWE classification discrepancies exist for a few findings.

Items.Notes: Run 2 explicitly identified the format string vulnerability in the runtime logger with the exact evidence quote and correct CWE-134 classification.
The factorial computation loop (result *= i) lacks overflow checks, but Run 2 did not report this vulnerability.
stage_deferred_history_flush captures a scratch buffer from the memory pool, but cleanup() frees the pool before async tasks complete, causing a use-after-free. Run 2 missed this.
Run 2 correctly identified command injection in config validation with the exact evidence quote and CWE-78 classification.
Run 2 correctly identified the stack buffer overflow in input processing with the exact evidence quote and CWE-120 classification.
ThreadSafeCounter::increment reads value_ outside the lock_guard, creating a race condition. Run 2 missed this.
Run 2 correctly identified the emergency override logic bomb/backdoor with the exact evidence quote, though it classified it as CWE-287 instead of CWE-511.
load_config concatenates config_dir_ and filename without sanitization, enabling path traversal. Run 2 missed this.
Run 2 correctly identified the heap buffer overflow in the parser with the exact evidence quote, though it classified it as CWE-120 instead of CWE-122.
Run 2 correctly identified the hardcoded credentials with the exact evidence quote and CWE-798 classification.
generate_session_token uses std::mt19937 with a narrow uniform distribution (1000-9999), making tokens predictable. Run 2 missed this.
log_debug_message uses static std::tm cached_time with localtime(), which is not thread-safe. Run 2 missed this.
append_override_audit_event constructs a shell command to write to a temp file path derived from environment variables, risking insecure temporary file handling. Run 2 missed this.
authenticated_ and session_token_ are never reset or cleared after a session ends, leading to persistent authentication state. Run 2 missed this.
handle_variable_command calls std::stod(tokens[3]) without verifying tokens.size() >= 4, risking unhandled exceptions. Run 2 missed this.
MemoryPool::allocate calculates remaining = previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES using size_t, which can underflow if previous_size is small. Run 2 missed this.
parse_expression recursively calls parse_factor, which calls parse_expression on PAREN_OPEN without checking MAX_RECURSION_DEPTH, enabling unbounded recursion. Run 2 missed this.
ExpressionEvaluator::evaluate_cached accesses and modifies result_cache_ without acquiring cache_mutex_, causing a data race. Run 2 missed this.
load_config checks std::filesystem::exists, sleeps, then opens the file, creating a classic TOCTOU race window. Run 2 missed this.
Run 2 correctly identified the division by zero vulnerability in route scoring with the exact evidence quote and CWE-369 classification.
